_comment: Documents for the harvester to retrieve. Written by agents that need a citation resolved to
bytes; consumed by .github/workflows/harvest.yml, which runs on GitHub's infrastructure because
the build container has no outbound egress. See docs/HARVEST.md.
Fields: id (stable key), url, optional note, optional headers, optional expect ('json'|'pdf')
to have the harvester verify content type, optional refetch:true to re-retrieve.
SET 'expect' WHENEVER YOU KNOW THE FORMAT. Run #1 established that unauthenticated requests to
catalog.archives.gov/api/v2 return HTTP 200 carrying the JavaScript app shell rather than 401.
A 2xx alone does not mean you received the document you asked for.

items.note: Run #1 returned 200 with an HTML app shell - no API key configured. With expect:json the harvester now marks this ok:false instead of appearing to succeed. Re-fetch once NARA_API_KEY is set in repository secrets.

Run #1 returned 404 'dataset.missing' for id hp9q-qxhx - the dataset identifier is wrong and needs re-deriving from the FCC open data catalogue. Retained deliberately: this is a live example of a citation that does not resolve.
